sentences.text:
Pampa Ghosh Bhowmick & Anr vs Unknown on 29 December,
2025
29.12.2025
 Jpd-1 Calcutta High Court
Ct. no. 6 In the Circuit Bench at Jalpaiguri
 Sb/Ss Appellate Jurisdiction
 Crr 625 of 2025
 With
 Cran 1 of 2025

In the matter of : Pampa Ghosh Bhowmick & Anr.
 ...petitioners
 Mr. Soupal Chatterjee
 Mr. Anupam Das ...for the Petitioners
 Re: Cran 1 of 2025

Learned counsel for the petitioners has prayed for
 condonation of delay.
Considering the grounds as made out and the grounds  as stated and sufficient cause being shown, the delay is hereby  condoned.
Accordingly, CRAN 1 of 2025 is disposed of.

The revisional application has been preferred challenging the order dated 2.9.2024 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, 2nd Court, Siliguri in connection with Siliguri Police Station case no.
642 of 2022 dated 4.7.2022 for the alleged offence punishable under Sections 406/420/120B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 corresponding to G.R. case no. 3016 of 2022, presently pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 2nd Court, Siliguri thereby issuing warrant of arrest against the petitioners.
2.
Upon hearing of learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners and on perusing the materials on record, it appears that charge-sheet in the present case has already been submitted.

3. Considering the said fact, the impugned order be stayed for a period of 10 days with a direction that the petitioners shall surrender before the Trial court and pray for bail before the Trial court,
Pampa Ghosh Bhowmick & Anr vs Unknown on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162417090/
1 which the Trial court shall consider in accordance with law.
4.
